name: file_summary
task:
Add exactly one new public tool, file_summary(path), to your editable seed under harness/.
It must return an object with path (relative workspace path), bytes (UTF-8 byte count), characters (Unicode character count), lines (len(text.splitlines())), and words (len(text.split())).
Preserve CRLF when reading, so both newline characters count.
Empty files have zero for all four counts.
Support UTF-8 files up to WRITE_LIMIT characters (100000); reject larger files, invalid UTF-8, directories and paths outside the workspace.
Use the existing Workspace.path validation.
Register the tool in TOOL_SPECS so native and JSON descriptions share its definition.
Add a focused new test file in harness/tests.
Update documentation only where needed to explain the new public interface.
Preserve every existing test and the agent loop.
Change runtime code only in harness/autoproteus/tools.py and harness/autoproteus/providers.py; keep the patch small.
Read the upgrade recipe and relevant source before editing; search and read useful sections instead of scanning every file.
Run python3 harness/seed.py check early and after edits; inspect failures and repair them.
Add tests for Unicode at the exact character limit, CRLF, invalid UTF-8 and rejected writes preserving bytes.
Exercise the new tool on a disposable real file using python3 harness/seed.py check --tool with its name and --arguments containing its JSON arguments; inspect the returned values.
Use todo.txt if it helps track the work.
There is no network and no package installation.
Finish with a concise explanation of the change and checks. The host records files, diffs, fingerprints and command results; no separate report file is required.
Finish as completed only once the feature is implemented and the entire candidate test suite passes.

name: append_text
task:
Add exactly one new public tool, append_text(path, content), to your editable seed under harness/.
Append UTF-8 content to an existing UTF-8 file, or create it (and parent directories if necessary).
Preserve existing bytes exactly, including CRLF.
Return path (relative workspace path) and bytes (the final file's UTF-8 byte count).
The final text must fit WRITE_LIMIT characters (100000).
Reject non-string content, invalid UTF-8 existing files, directories, oversized final text and paths outside the workspace before changing the file; failed validation must preserve existing bytes.
